summary: Jayud Global Logistics Ltd filed a Form 6-K with exhibits that include a notice of its 2025 Annual General Meeting (AGM) and proxy materials. The AGM covers routine proposals: approving audited financials and the annual report, authorizing a board-determined share consolidation (between 2:1 and 250:1) within three years, and an increase in authorized share capital to at least 50 million shares post-consolidation. There are no acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, or other special-situation events. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of a shareholder meeting. No deal terms are present.
